summary: The proposal defines proportionate planned evidence for FR-001–026 and SC-001–008: existing golden-rule/consent/archive/import checks are reused, new durability and protocol risks have fault-boundary checks, and Apple UX, timing, all-writer/SSE convergence and restore acceptance have concrete operational procedures. Static declaration inspection confirms the corrected Swift suite filters; the pilot dependency closure includes PR-58 and PR-59/60, and declared shared paths are serialized. One deterministic slice-ownership/file-budget defect remains in PR-34. No product build or test was run; future bridge/AI sizing, hardware measurements and owner/risk acceptance remain explicit gates, not claimed results.

findings.description: PR-34 cannot add and test the bb-client workspace crate within its declared write paths and five-product-file cap. Creating this new workspace package necessarily updates the already tracked rust/Cargo.lock to record bb-client (and any newly required SQLite dependencies). The map owns five product files but omits that lockfile. Following the required cargo test therefore leaves an undeclared sixth product file, and retaining the required pinned lockfile makes the mandatory slice-budget gate fail. This is a known missing build input, separate from unmeasured empirical bridge/AI sizes.
evidence: specs/026-rust-core-sync/tasks.md:95 (T034 creates bb-client manifest/lib.rs and SQLite storage); tasks.md:1390–1422 (PR-34 owns bb-client Cargo.toml, lib.rs, storage.rs, locking.rs and rust/Cargo.toml, but no rust/Cargo.lock; budget.files is 5).

specs/026-rust-core-sync/tasks.md:11 and :17 require counting Cargo.lock as product, respecting owned write paths and running the slice budget check; tasks.md:1415 requires cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p bb-client storage. PR-03/04/05 already establish the tracked shared rust/Cargo.lock.

scripts/check_slice_budget.py:24–39 excludes only package-lock.json, uv.lock and Package.resolved, so Cargo.lock counts as a product file; product_changes at :56–68 counts every changed product file and main at :112–119 fails an exceeded declared cap.
cli/Cargo.toml:1–3 and cli/Cargo.lock:253–255 show the repository Cargo lockfile records its own local package, independently of external dependency sizing.
findings.recommendation: Add rust/Cargo.lock to PR-34 owned paths and account for it in the product-file cap (at least six). Include its actual delta in the 390-line measurement and revise the boundary if necessary; keep the lockfile counted under the existing gate.
